messages:
Maya Chopra: Taking over primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC window — grabbing the pager now. Travel delay earlier so doing an opportunistic swap. I have runbook links and the key watchlist. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handback

incident-bot: [AUTO] Page assigned to Maya Chopra (P0) — latency-spike-service-x — 1748123480. Pager: https://pd.redwood/INC12345

Jordan Lee: thanks Maya. quick heads-up — dedicated-pool-3 showing elevated queueing (GPU util ~78% last 5m). runbook says scale if >75% and queueing >200ms.

Maya Chopra: copying. I'll scale dedicated-pool-3 now. command I will run: ```rdctl pools scale --id=dedicated-pool-3 --replicas 6``` — will post when done. also starting telemetry smoke.

Samir Patel: i'm shadowing as secondary until 23:30 then Olivia takes over. @Olivia Ramos can you confirm availability and phone/alt?

Olivia Ramos: confirmed. I'm on secondary 23:30-07:30 UTC and reachable on phone +1-415-555-0199 and Signal. If you need a hot swap ping me and @Samir. Added canary alert to my phone.

Maya Chopra: coverage note — there is a 02:00-02:30 UTC gap in the schedule where no secondary was set (legacy rota hole). Samir can you extend by 30m? If not i'll cover.

Samir Patel: I can extend to 02:30, no problem. Updated my off time and the rota. New rota link: https://redwood.internal/schedules/rotation-2026#team-oncall-week12

Maya Chopra: scaled pool finished: ```OK scaled dedicated-pool-3 -> 6 replicas``` — monitoring queue and p50. Also toggled a temporary prefix cache for search endpoints per runbook: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ops/cache -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"prefix":"search","ttl":600}'```

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident update — latency-spike-service-x: mitigation applied (scaled pool + prefix cache). p50 dropped from 820ms -> 190ms over 3m. Marking as mitigated but not closed.

Jordan Lee: nice mitigation. Reminder/fallback pointer: if p50 > 600ms for >5m, follow fallback-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-to-small-model — that includes model downgrade + rate limiting rule.

Maya Chopra: noted and added to the handoff checklist. I'll also run the smoke test set before final handoff to Olivia at 23:30: 5 queries, p50 < 250ms each.

Olivia Ramos: please add a quick note in the handoff channel with actions taken so I can pick up context: `/handoff add 1748123456 — primary:Maya; secondary:Samir->Olivia; actions:scaled dedicated-pool-3, enabled prefix cache, smoke tests running; watch:p50/p95; links:[runbook, rota]`

Samir Patel: handoff note added and linked runbooks + incident ticket. Also attached the snippet I ran for telemetry extraction: ```jq '.metrics[] | select(.name=="gpu_util")' telemetry_dump.json```

Maya Chopra: final plan: monitor for 20m after scaling. If we see sustained tail latency or another page, escalate to oncall-sre and consider failover to smaller model variant. I'll post final handoff at 23:30 after successful smoke. :thumbsup:

Olivia Ramos: ack. thanks all. I'll be ready to take primary at 23:30 as planned and will check the incident ticket on takeover.

Maya Chopra: final handoff (23:30): primary -> Olivia Ramos, secondary -> Samir Patel (shadow), actions: scaled pool, enabled cache, smoke tests 5/5 passed (p50<240ms). Leaving watch window 30m. Good luck and ping if anything odd. :rocket:

incident-bot: [AUTO] Handoff recorded — thread: 1748123456; primary: Olivia Ramos; secondary: Samir Patel; notes: scaled pool, cache enabled, mitigation verified."
